searchText: <@291925846556540928> update the yt livestream link for todays call please so i can post in relevant subreddits a bit in advance. thanks! Call in 2 hours! Livestream link available in 10 .minutes youtube stream: https://youtu.be/DVePZUQOyFk youtube video title is for last call fixed My notes: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/B1PSWKFbv **c00gan** Do we know yet about how many transactions can fit into an Eth 2 block? None yet 😂 Phase 0 (beacon chain) and Phase 1 (Sharding) don't have a notion of transaction. However, the data consensus capacity of Eth2 when fully running is planned to be around 2-3MB/s (a little under 1000x that of Eth1 right now), so that give some order of magnitude. But Txs might be bigger, or more complex, so it's hard to compare directly. **c00gan** (in reply to **<@573787335796326400>**) 👍👍🙏🙏
